name: What kind of paint is best for post-remodel finish painting?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for post-remodel finish painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best kind of paint depends on the specific area and desired finish. For high-traffic areas like hallways and kitchens, durable, washable paints with a satin or semi-gloss finish are often recommended. For living areas and bedrooms, matte or eggshell finishes can offer a softer look. We typically use high-quality, low-VOC (volatile organic compound) paints to ensure durability and minimize odors, especially in newly renovated spaces. The choice also depends on the substrate being painted.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best paint depends on the area; durable satin/semi-gloss for high-traffic, matte/eggshell for living areas. Low-VOC paints are often preferred.
